learnings.claim: YouTube native title and thumbnail A/B test is not a Shorts experiment; Shorts packaging iteration must not be labeled as that product.
learnings.decision: Use sequential owned-channel metrics for Shorts experiments and reserve native A/B conclusions for eligible long-form only.
fallback_history: If native A/B eligibility is unclear, do not transfer the result to Shorts.
learnings.next_measurement: On the next Shorts analytics read use engaged views, retention, and AVD or APV rather than a native A/B result.
learnings.title: Native YouTube A/B tests do not cover Shorts

learnings.claim: URLs in Shorts descriptions and comments are non-clickable; a Related video link can be clickable in the Shorts player when advanced-feature access and eligibility are verified.
learnings.decision: Do not design a conversion CTA that depends on a raw description or comment URL; prefer native Related video only after access read-back.
fallback_history: Use a separately verified clickable surface; do not infer clickability from plain text.
learnings.next_measurement: On the next suitable Short, verify advanced-feature access before using Related video and do not claim conversion lift without owned analytics.
learnings.title: Shorts description and comment URLs are not the clickable route

learnings.claim: Per-workflow concurrency groups prevent duplicate runs of one workflow but do not serialize different workflows that push to the same branch.
learnings.decision: Use one repo-main-writers group with queue max for all workflows that commit to main, while retaining pull-rebase as a secondary conflict check.
failure_history: Ten write-capable workflows used separate concurrency groups, allowing cross-workflow pushes to overlap.
fallback_history: If a queued run reaches the 100-run limit or stalls, stop the unhealthy writer and preserve the existing pull-rebase conflict path.
learnings.next_measurement: Verify workflow validation, successful CI, and the next scheduled writer runs without push conflicts or canceled pending jobs.
learnings.title: Repository writers need one queued concurrency group

learnings.claim: POSIX flock protects processes sharing one checkout, while GitHub Contents API updates require the current blob SHA and serialized remote writes.
learnings.decision: Keep local flock plus atomic replace; remote writers must read the current blob SHA, write serially, and re-read after conflicts.
failure_history: A local file lock cannot coordinate independent GitHub runners or automation branches.
fallback_history: On conflict, fetch the new blob SHA and reassess the delta before one bounded retry.
learnings.next_measurement: Track HTTP 409 or 422 conflicts and verify successful read-back on the merged main branch.
learnings.title: Local and remote write locks are separate

learnings.claim: Rights clearance is necessary but not sufficient for revenue-targeted Shorts; substantive original contribution is also required, and optional music can change Creator Pool allocation.
learnings.decision: Before publish require commercial rights clearance and a distinct originality or reused-content gate; evaluate music only when it adds narrative or retention value.
fallback_history: If rights or originality cannot be verified, replace with original or licensed footage and original narration.
learnings.next_measurement: On the next Shorts production decision record rights source, originality evidence, and whether music is used.
learnings.title: Shorts revenue needs originality plus rights, and music is not revenue-neutral

learnings.claim: Authorized YouTube Analytics can segment owned-video discovery by insightTrafficSourceType and, for supported sources, insightTrafficSourceDetail. Raw views do not establish feed, browse, or search mix.
learnings.decision: Before changing packaging or distribution, classify discovery source only from an authorized report. Otherwise mark traffic source unknown. Do not invent search terms or external pages.
failure_history: Markdown learning learn_youtube_traffic_source_feedback_loop_20261002 was absent from learning_ledger.json after the 18:30 write, so the machine set could not discover it.
fallback_history: If authorized Analytics or Studio read-back is unavailable, keep traffic source unknown and do not change packaging from raw views.
learnings.next_measurement: On the next owned Short with authorized Analytics, record insightTrafficSourceType and supported detail beside engaged views and retention. Do not infer source mix from raw views.
learnings.title: Traffic source must be classified before packaging changes

learnings.claim: From 24 August 2026 YouTube counts a view when playback starts, while Shorts earnings still use engaged views and YPP eligibility still uses qualified views.
learnings.decision: Annotate the counting change before comparing historical raw views and prioritize engaged views, watch time, and retention.
fallback_history: If Analytics access is unavailable, keep the methodology note and do not treat raw-view deltas as content-performance proof.
learnings.next_measurement: On the next owned-channel analytics read record whether engagedViews and retention metrics are available.
learnings.title: Post-August 2026 raw Shorts views are not comparable without a methodology note

learnings.claim: GitHub Apps should request only the minimum permissions needed; Contents and Workflows permissions are separate capabilities.
learnings.decision: For repository automation, grant Contents only when code/file access is required and add Workflows only when .github/workflows files must be edited.
failure_history: Treating a visible or installed GitHub App as proof of appropriately scoped access can overstate both capability and safety.
fallback_history: If the required permission cannot be confirmed, keep the integration available_unverified and use read-only/manual review instead of expanding access.
learnings.next_measurement: Compare the documented minimum with the actual installed app permissions when authorized account-level visibility is available.
learnings.title: Separate GitHub App Contents and Workflows permissions
